basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old software engineer living in Austin, Texas. I've been fascinated with psychedelics for over a decade, both from a recreational and a philosophical perspective. In my free time, I play inline hockey and I'm an avid gamer, particularly enjoying titles like Resident Evil 4. I love discussing game strategies and sharing tips with fellow enthusiasts. While I'm single, I enjoy socializing with a close-knit group of friends who share similar interests. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during weekends. My job allows me flexibility, so I often find time to engage in various online communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in psychedelics comes from years of self-directed learning, engaging in community discussions, and reading scientific literature. I also have a background in computer science, which I apply to my work as a software engineer. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-taught through extensive gameplay and community interaction.
